candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from the onERC721Received selector to bytes4(0).
Change the return value to the ERC-165 supportsInterface selector instead of the onERC721Received selector.
Change the return value to the approve(bytes4(0x095ea7b3)) selector instead of the onERC721Received selector.
Delete the statement `baseToken = _baseToken;` so baseToken remains address(0) after initialization.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = address(0);` so baseToken is always the zero address after initialization.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken is set to the NFT address instead of the provided base token.
